_notes: Squad roles and starting kits (design doc, Roles: proposed). A kit is base_kit plus the role's kit, as [item id, count] pairs, taken in order (carrier before plates). 'weapon_note' says what stands in for a weapon the item list doesn't have yet. fire_teams lists each team's slots in order; slots pair into battle buddies (1st+2nd, 3rd+4th). Every team keeps exactly one medic slot. Medical loadouts (design doc, The kit and Medics): the medic carries a trauma kit plus extra tourniquets, gauze, bandages, chest seals, splints, morphine and NPAs, IVs, an IO kit, fluids, a pressure bag, decompression needles, a pulse oximeter, epinephrine, atropine, adenosine, a defibrillator, a surgery kit, burn dressings and a hypothermia blanket; everyone else carries an IFAK. MOLLE: the base kit puts three double mag pouches, an IFAK pouch and a tourniquet holder (with a tourniquet in it, on top of the one in the IFAK: one on the kit, one in the kit) on the carrier; role kits add theirs (radio and binoculars for the team leader, a sustainment pouch and knife for the medic, grenade pouches for the grenadier...) before what goes in them.

grenadier.name: Grenadier
grenadier.weapon_note: M4A1 without an underbarrel launcher until there is one

_breacher_note: Breacher (Captain, 2026-10-20: "we need breacher roles for the player team", "they use breaching charges"): leads a building entry first at the door (SquadAI breach plan): a breaching charge in Aware/Combat while he has one, the Mossberg on the door frame or a kick when he hasn't, a slow quiet open in Stealth unless ordered otherwise; the stack goes in after his breach and a bang. Like anti_tank, not in fire_teams: a player's pick or a deliberate cast (roster role, command menu Team > Assign role).
_lx3_note: LX-3 presets (near-future hardware doc, docs/near_future_hardware.md): any role in lx3_capable can be kitted with the LX-3 Assist Frame and Visor Helmet in place of the normal helmet (Roles.apply_kit(inv, role, true) / Roles.lx3_kit(role)). The soldier's stored role is unchanged (still 'medic', 'team_leader', ...), so squad_ai's role checks (Roles.MEDIC and so on) keep working; this only swaps what the kit puts in the inventory. Not wired into AI auto-fill (same as anti_tank): a mission, loadout screen or roster hire opts a soldier into it deliberately.
